title: UniRTM Plugin Manifest Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for UniRTM plugin manifests (<plugin-id>.manifest.json)

name.description: Unique plugin identifier following vendor/name syntax (e.g. 'snowdreamtech/docker' or 'rust')

description.description: Brief description of the plugin's features

contributes.description: Declarations of capabilities and configuration extended by this plugin

configuration.description: Schema definition of configuration properties contributed by this plugin under [plugins."<id>".config]

type.description: Data type expected for this configuration setting

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this configuration setting controls

default.description: Default value applied if not explicitly overridden by user

enum.description: List of strictly permitted values for this property
